verdict.rationale: The official CLI documents a non-interactive, CI/CD-friendly install path: `npx skills add <repo> --skill <name> -g -a claude-code -y`. Skill, agent target and scope are all set by flags, and `-y` skips confirmation prompts, so an agent can run it headlessly from start to finish. Private repos reuse the git authentication already configured, which adds no interactive login step, and `--list` lets the agent discover skills without prompts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that `-y` suppresses every prompt in practice (e.g., in agent sandboxes or for private-repo auth).
